edits.new: 现代虚构场景之一：一家小店打算在旺季前大批备货，整套计划的前提是供应商不会临时涨价。动手之前先打一个电话把这个前提问清楚，比事后懊悔有用。韩信是先派人探知李左车的计策没被采用，才敢进兵的；他的胆子建立在一次确认上。
edits.reason: FIX check: first scene repeated the open-question scenario; replaced with a scene drawn from J-E4 (verify the key assumption before acting).

edits.new: First modern scene, fictional: a small shop plans to stock up heavily before the busy season, and the whole plan rests on the supplier not raising prices at the last minute. One phone call to check that assumption before buying is worth more than regret afterwards. Han Xin advanced only after his scouts confirmed that Li Zuoche's plan had been turned down; his boldness rested on a check.
edits.reason: Match zh replacement.
Review: supply-line reasoning is from J-E2 and 赵王歇 from J-E6.
